probes.summary: Live OPNsense addressing, routing, pf/NAT, and both HTTP paths were verified successfully.
limitations: No reboot was authorized, so post-reboot persistence was not directly exercised.
configctl interface list returned "Action not allowed or missing"; equivalent ifconfig, netstat, pfctl, and saved-config evidence was available.

probes.summary: Gateway and services are active, but stale/debug residue was found on OPNsense and temporary probe artifacts remained on Ubuntu nodes.
limitations: This was read-only; no cleanup or recovery mutation was authorized.

assertions.summary: All declared zone addresses and data-plane routes are present on the intended interfaces.

evidence.observation: vtnet1 has 10.80.3.1/24, vtnet2 has 10.80.1.1/24, and vtnet3 has 10.80.2.1/24. Connected routes use vtnet1 for 10.80.3.0/24, vtnet2 for 10.80.1.0/24, and vtnet3 for 10.80.2.0/24. Saved config maps wan=vtnet1, opt1/LAN=vtnet2, and opt2/DMZ=vtnet3 with the same addresses.

evidence.command: ip -4 addr show; ip -4 route show; ip route get 10.80.2.1
evidence.observation: enp8s0 owns 10.80.2.10/24; default route is via 10.80.2.1 dev enp8s0; route lookup reports 10.80.2.1 dev enp8s0 src 10.80.2.10.

evidence.command: ip -4 addr show; ip -4 route show; ip route get 10.80.2.10
evidence.observation: enp8s0 owns 10.80.1.10/24; default route is via 10.80.1.1 dev enp8s0; route lookup reports 10.80.2.10 via 10.80.1.1 dev enp8s0 src 10.80.1.10.

evidence.command: ip -4 addr show; ip -4 route show; ip route get 10.80.3.1
evidence.observation: enp8s0 owns 10.80.3.10/24; default route is via 10.80.3.1 dev enp8s0; route lookup reports 10.80.3.1 dev enp8s0 src 10.80.3.10.

limitations: Reboot persistence was not tested because the authored probe is read-only.

assertions.summary: The LAN direct endpoint and WAN published endpoint both return the required response, and the active OPNsense DNAT is exactly WAN TCP 8443 to DMZ TCP 8080.

evidence.observation: Active NAT contains one published rule: rdr pass on vtnet1 inet proto tcp from any to (vtnet1) port = 8443 -> 10.80.2.10 port 8080. Saved config contains the matching target/local-port and description antrieb: publish DMZ HTTP on WAN 8443.
Route uses src 10.80.1.10 via 10.80.1.1 on enp8s0. HTTP returned 200 OK and body infraset-dmz directly from 10.80.2.10:8080.
Route uses src 10.80.3.10 on enp8s0. HTTP returned 200 OK and body infraset-dmz from 10.80.3.1:8443.

limitations: The authored plan did not authorize additional negative connectivity probes or a reboot.

assertions.summary: Concrete stale/debug residue remains despite coherent active pf/NAT state and no failed Ubuntu units.

evidence.command: find /conf -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name 'config.xml*' -o -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.pcap' -o -name '*.cap' \) -exec stat -f '%N %z bytes %Sm' {} \;; find /conf /var/run /tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*pending*' -o -iname '*dirty*' -o -iname '*config*.lock' -o -iname '*filter*.lock' -o -iname '*.debug' -o -iname '*.old' \) -print
evidence.observation: Outside the normal /conf/backup history, /conf/config.xml.bak-infraset-original and /conf/config.xml.bak-infraset-before-pass-mode remain. /tmp contains filter_update_tables.lock, ifconfig.debug, ifconfig.debug.old, rules.debug, and rules.debug.old. Active pf reported one publish rdr and one DMZ-to-LAN block rule.
No failed units were listed. Temporary residue includes /tmp/cap-peer.log, /tmp/ping2.out, /tmp/selfarp.log, /tmp/dmz-lan.out, and /tmp/selfping.out.
No failed units were listed. Temporary residue includes /tmp/cap-peer.log and /tmp/ping3.out.
No failed units were listed. Temporary residue includes /tmp/cap-peer.log, /tmp/wan-direct.err, /tmp/ping4.out, /tmp/wan-direct.out, /tmp/wan-direct2.err, /tmp/wan-direct2.out, and /tmp/wan-lan.out.

failures: Node1 has stale backup files outside the normal /conf/backup history and multiple explicit debug/lock artifacts.
Ubuntu nodes retain temporary capture, ping, and WAN/DMZ diagnostic logs.
limitations: The read-only authored probe did not permit removing the residue or testing reboot persistence.

actions_performed: Executed the authored read-only probes in order using managed exec on node1, node2, node3, and node4.
Performed no configuration mutation, reboot, or evaluator test-data creation.
Called complete_evidence exactly once after all live checks were complete.
